blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines will adopt an international bond pricing convention on Jan. 4, 2027, covering eligible peso-denominated government and corporate securities as regulators seek to attract more investors and deepen market liquidity. On Friday, the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) said the transition covers eligible peso-denominated, coupon-bearing securities. READ: PH to iron out bond […]...
